name: Jacob Czepluch
description:
I've been working on Ethereum for 11 years. Spanning from the Python Ethereum client, to payment channels (Raiden Network), to security tooling at Phylax Systems and now contributing to the Solidity language.
On the side, I've organized the Copenhagen Ethereum Meetup for almost 11 years and have been part of DoD in Berlin, organizing EthBerlin and Protocolberg.
